title: Ulyana and the Blue Hour
author: Lior Zhou
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
